::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/request_logs"}
#docs
Secrets are masked before a request is stored, and response bodies are kept for writes and errors only. A request with an invalid key or an unknown path is not logged. A test key sees test requests only; a live key, live requests only. Reads are kept 30 days, writes 90 days. Requires the developer permission in the dashboard.

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of requests to return (1–1000, default 50). |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`. |
| `offset` | `string` | no | Same token as `starting_after`, under the name `next_offset`. |
| `q` | `string` | no | A request id (`req_…`) matches that request. Other text matches the path, route, idempotency key or trace id. |
| `api_key` | `string` | no | Only requests made with this API key (`key_…`). |
| `business` | `string` | no | Only requests to this business (`biz_…`). |
| `customer` | `string` | no | Only requests that name this customer (`cus_…`). |
| `trace_id` | `string` | no | Only requests with this trace id. |
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | no | Only requests sent with this `Idempotency-Key`. |
| `created_at[on_or_after]` | `string` | no | Filter on the time the request arrived (UTC days or unix seconds); every date operator applies. |
| `status[gte]` | `integer` | no | Filter on the HTTP status, e.g. `status[gte]=400&status[lt]=500`; every number operator applies. |
| `duration_ms[gte]` | `integer` | no | Filter on the duration in milliseconds; every number operator applies. |
| `method[is]` | `string` | no | Filter on the HTTP method. |
| `kind[is]` | `string` | no | `read` or `write`. |
| `source[is]` | `string` | no | `api` (an API key) or `dashboard` (a team member, writes only). |
| `livemode[is]` | `string` | no | `test` or `live`. |
| `path[contains]` | `string` | no | Filter on the request path; every text operator applies. |
| `route[is]` | `string` | no | Filter on the route pattern, e.g. `/v1/businesses/:biz/customers`. |
| `error_type[is]` | `string` | no | Filter on `error.type` of the error answer. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `request_log`. One of `request_log`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | `req_…`; the `Request-Id` header of the response. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the request log was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.method` | `string` | The method. |
| `data.path` | `string` | Without the query string. |
| `data.route` | `string | null` | Route pattern. |
| `data.query` | `string | null` | Query string, secrets masked. |
| `data.api_version` | `string` | The request log's api version. One of `v1`. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | The request log's kind. One of `read`, `write`. |
| `data.status` | `integer | null` | Null when the client closed the connection first. |
| `data.duration_ms` | `integer | null` | The request log's duration ms. |
| `data.source` | `string` | Where the request log comes from. One of `api`, `dashboard`. |
| `data.api_key` | `object | null` | The request log's api key. |
| `data.member` | `object | null` | The team member, for dashboard writes. |
| `data.business` | `string | null` | `biz_…` |
| `data.livemode` | `string | null` | The request log's livemode. One of `test`, `live`, `null`. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | `string | null` | The request log's idempotency key. |
| `data.idempotency_outcome` | `string | null` | The request log's idempotency outcome. One of `new`, `replayed`, `mismatch`, `in_progress`, `missing`, `null`. |
| `data.error_type` | `string | null` | The request log's error type. |
| `data.trace_id` | `string | null` | The request log's trace id. |
| `data.customer` | `string | null` | `cus_…`, when the request names one. |
| `data.ip` | `string | null` | The request log's ip. |
| `data.user_agent` | `string | null` | The request log's user agent. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string | null` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |
| `total` | `integer | null` | Total number of matching rows. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page of requests (no bodies) |
| `400` | Unknown filter or invalid value |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/request_logs?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
